audience: AP and finance teams at construction companies
headline: Still keying invoices into the ERP?
symptoms: Every invoice is matched to its PO by hand
Retainage and blank lien waivers slip through
Posting takes minutes per invoice, hundreds of times a month
build: Invoice intake that reads the invoice, pulls the PO or subcontract, checks one against the other and types it into your ERP. The AP clerk and the project manager each approve before it moves on.

seo.description: Construction AP invoice automation: reads each invoice, matches it to the PO or subcontract, checks retainage and waivers, and posts it after approval.
faq: No. It reads, matches and enters invoices into the ERP you already use. The ERP stays the system of record.
The AP clerk, then the project manager. Nothing posts without an approval on record.
What if our ERP has no API?
Import files, a database connection or browser automation can post the entry. The approval steps stay the same.
